title: shadPS4 0.7.0: official development build
summary: shadPS4 published 0.7.0 on March 22, 2025. The release record documents an official development build for the PlayStation 4 emulator project.

blocks.text: The shadPS4 project published version 0.7.0 on March 22, 2025. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official release description states: Another exciting release coming from shadPS4 team . A lot of new features (FSR,HDR) and a lot fixups in this new release . It is really a special day for me since it is my birthday as well (shadow) and 24 years after first pcsx2 release.
